# Nonogram Puzzle Game

Nonogram is a classic logic puzzle game where you fill cells according to row and column clues.
Features include multi-level deduction, auto-solve, custom puzzles, image-to-puzzle conversion,
puzzle library browsing, save/export (code / JSON / image / webpage parsing), GIF replay,
user accounts, and multilingual support (Simplified Chinese / Traditional Chinese / English / Japanese).

## Key pages

- [Nonogram Game](https://nonogram.amiya1223.top/)
- [GitHub Source Repository](https://github.com/Amiya0426/nonogram-game)
